title: Priming and Loading a MinION Flowcell
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7q5hmy6
materials: Thaw the following reagents at room temperature before placing on ice: Sequencing buffer (SQB) Loading beads (LB) Flush buffer (FLB) Flush tether (FLT)

steps.title: Prepare FLB Mixture
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL FLT to the FLB tube and mix well by vortexing.

steps.title: Install MinION Flowcell
steps.instruction: If required, place a new MinION flowcell onto the MinION.

substeps.instruction: Push one end of the flowcell under the clip

steps.title: Prime Flowcell with FLB
steps.instruction: Load 800 µL of FLB (plus FLT) into the flow cell via the inlet port.

substeps.instruction: Dispense slowly and smoothly to avoid introducing air bubbles

steps.title: Prepare Library Dilution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 75 µL library dilution in a new tube using the following components: 37.5 µL SQB, 25.5 µL LB, and 12 µL Final library.

substeps.instruction: Dilute library in EB if required
Mix LB immediately before use as they settle quickly

steps.title: Load Library Dilution
steps.instruction: Load the 75 µL library dilution into the flow cell via the SpotON sample port.

substeps.instruction: Mix the prepared library gently by pipetting up and down just prior to loading
Add the dilution in a dropwise fashion
Ensure each drop siphons into the port before adding the next

steps.title: Seal Flowcell Ports
steps.instruction: Close the flowcell ports and lid.

substeps.instruction: Gently replace the SpotON sample port cover, ensuring the bung enters the SpotON port

steps.title: Expose Priming Port
steps.instruction: Rotate the inlet port cover clockwise by 90° so that the priming port is visible.

steps.title: Remove Air from Inlet Port
steps.instruction: Remove air from the inlet port using a P1000 pipette set to 800 µL.

substeps.instruction: Place the tip in the inlet port, holding it perpendicularly to the plane of the flowcell
Turn the volume dial anti-clockwise to remove air
Ensure not to remove so much volume that air is introduced onto the rectangular array via the outlet

steps.title: Open SpotON Port
steps.instruction: Gently lift the SpotON cover to open the SpotON port.

steps.title: Initiate Library Siphon
steps.instruction: Load another 200 µL of FLB (plus FLT) into the flow cell via the inlet port to initiate a siphon at the SpotON port for the library dilution.
